about: Targets for tests/e2e/prod-xr.mjs (week 8 ticket 02): the production bundle has no test hook, so the emulated hand aims at these world points (metres, IWER global space = IWSDK world). The head is a seated player looking 25 degrees down; with no planes the diorama floats in front of them (headRelativePlacement). tests/unit/prodXrTargets.test.ts recomputes knobs and chute from the game's placement code to within 1 mm. Enter XR needs no point: the script clicks the page's DOM #enter-xr.
